user_id, national_tax_id and personal_email kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy
number is server-kept and named by the anchor, so it is not a cell

user_contact_update_verification.evidence: the request gives the office line as +1-212-555-0199 and the check expects +12125550199 only; the seed holds phones both with dashes (+1-555-000-008) and without (+12068306386), so either spelling satisfies the request and the phone cell accepts both

comprehensive_cross_table_state_verifica.evidence: a conjunction of the task, case, profile and phone changes that other carried checks test; its phone part takes the same repair as the user check, accepting +1-212-555-0199 as the request writes it or +12125550199

audit_trail_verification.evidence: it tests only the server-kept updated_at of task 26, case 11, profile 21 and user 21; with those predicates dropped it tests only that the four rows exist, which holds on the seed. disagreement: disposition: A repaired, B weak; chose weak because the check has no cell beyond the row ids once its timestamps are dropped, and each row's requested change is tested by its own requirement

notes:
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that the New Hire Onboarding service (hr_service 11) remains manual; one pass has it, the other does not; dropped because the request asks only to check the service, which is a read: it is manual on the seed, no listed tool writes hr_service, and the request does not forbid a change, so the stay could not fail and adds nothing.
disagreement: missing requirement: that case 11's assignment group is one Joanne Simpson belongs to; one pass has it, the other left the group untested; kept because the policy requires a case to be assigned to an active user in its assignment group, she is a member only of group 10 and not of the case's group 4, and the case's group is a field update_hr_case writes.
disagreement: the cells of the stay on task 27; resolved on that requirement.
disagreement: the disposition of audit_trail_verification; resolved in its evidence.
The two passes otherwise agree on every row, id and cell. One split the profile's location and position, and the case's status, priority and assignee, into separate requirements; each is one change to one row asked in one sentence, and is one requirement here. referential_integrity_verification is a conjunction over the task's parent case, the case's assignee and the profile's user, so it is carried jointly by the task, case, profile and user requirements.
The acting user, Karen Watkins, is an administrator, whom the policy bars from routine HR case work. The request asks for exactly that work (the case's status, priority and assignee, and a task), and the benchmark expects it done, so the request is taken as deciding the final state; an agent that halted on this restriction would meet none of the case requirements.
'Move the entire case to work in progress' is read as the case's status. The New Hire Onboarding service has no service template, so the move should generate no new tasks.
Record numbers in the benchmark's checks are server-kept and are left out of the cells; each requirement's id anchor names the same row. Andrew Bell's other case, HRC0000768 (HR Accounts Inquiry), is outside the request, which names HRC0000721 by number.
national_tax_id is stored in plain text on the seed although the policy asks for encryption; the benchmark's plain-text value is kept.
